source_note: Verify with official gazette, cybercrime officer, or a licensed lawyer. Indian Penal Code provisions transitioned to Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023.

blackmail.title: Extortion & Blackmail
blackmail.it_act: Information Technology Act Section 66E (Violation of privacy) & 66D
blackmail.description: Demanding money by putting a person or their family in fear of injury, reputational harm, or exposing personal data is a cognizable criminal offence.
blackmail.rbi_directive: RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (Sept 2022) strictly prohibit recovery agents from resorting to intimidation, harassment, or verbal abuse.

morphed_photo_threat.title: Morphed Photos / Obscene Defamation
morphed_photo_threat.bns_sections: BNS Section 79 (Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty) / Section 356 (Defamation)
morphed_photo_threat.it_act: Information Technology Act Section 67 & 67A (Transmitting sexually explicit or obscene material in electronic form), Section 66E
morphed_photo_threat.description: Morphing personal photographs extracted from device galleries or threatening to publish defamatory images is punishable with rigorous imprisonment and non-bailable warrants.
morphed_photo_threat.rbi_directive: Lending apps are explicitly barred from accessing mobile device media, photo galleries, or camera permissions without direct loan KYC requirement.

contact_threat.title: Harassment of Contacts / Phonebook Misuse
contact_threat.it_act: Information Technology Act Section 66E (Privacy infringement) & Section 43A
contact_threat.description: Threatening to contact relatives, employers, or phonebook contacts to shame the borrower is illegal. Contacts have no legal liability as guarantors.
contact_threat.rbi_directive: RBI explicitly mandates that Digital Lending Apps (DLAs) cannot access contact lists, call logs, or phonebook directories under any circumstances.

abusive_language.title: Verbal Abuse & Intentional Insult
abusive_language.bns_sections: BNS Section 352 (Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace)
abusive_language.it_act: Information Technology Act Section 66A (principles) & telecom harassment regulations
abusive_language.description: Using foul, degrading, or abusive language over phone or messaging apps constitutes harassment and breach of public peace.
abusive_language.rbi_directive: Lenders and recovery agents are forbidden from contacting borrowers at odd hours (before 8 AM or after 7 PM) or using derogatory terms.

fake_legal_threat.title: Fake Legal Notices & Court Summons
fake_legal_threat.bns_sections: BNS Section 336 (Forgery) / Section 338 (Forgery of valuable security / court document)
fake_legal_threat.it_act: Information Technology Act Section 66D (Cheating by personation using computer resource)
fake_legal_threat.description: Fabricating police notices, court warrants, or CBI/Cyber Cell arrest threats to compel payment constitutes forgery and fraud.
fake_legal_threat.rbi_directive: Debt recovery through intimidation with fake legal letterheads violates Fair Practices Code (FPC) and invites cancellation of lending registration.

impersonation_of_authority.title: Impersonation of Police or Public Servant
impersonation_of_authority.bns_sections: BNS Section 204 (Impersonating a public servant) / Section 318 (Cheating)
impersonation_of_authority.it_act: Information Technology Act Section 66D (Cheating by personation)
impersonation_of_authority.description: Recovery agents posing as police officers, cyber cell inspectors, or court bailiffs commit severe criminal offences.
impersonation_of_authority.rbi_directive: Only legitimate judicial recovery processes can be instituted by regulated entities; recovery agents have zero police powers.

payment_pressure.title: Unfair Coercive Recovery Practices
payment_pressure.bns_sections: BNS Section 351 (Intimidation where threats are implied)
payment_pressure.description: Continuous badgering, repeated calls within minutes, or threatening social boycott violates borrower protection norms.
payment_pressure.rbi_directive: RBI requires regulated entities to have dedicated grievance redressal officers and adhere to the Master Direction on Fair Practices.

neutral_reminder.title: Standard Due Date Reminder
neutral_reminder.it_act: Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations (TCCCPR)
neutral_reminder.description: Polite payment reminders detailing principal, balance due, and formal payment portal link.
neutral_reminder.rbi_directive: Must be sent through registered telemarketer (RTM) channels with verified sender IDs.
